scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday’s hearing-aid maintenance visit able to include the planned firmware update, not just routine cleaning.
Emerging Need: The appointment becomes dependent on a specific charging cable that is absent at home while a clinic loaner hold window is still open.
Decision Context: Saved preference limits the response to a reviewable, no-purchase communication path, and current clinic messages determine whether a compatible loaner can still be held.
Consequence: Once the hold cutoff passes, the missing prerequisite remains unresolved and the firmware portion cannot be preserved for the scheduled visit.

parameter.title: Rose City Hearing maintenance visit
parameter.description: Routine hearing-aid cleaning and firmware maintenance appointment.

parameter.subject: Friday maintenance visit accessory reminder
parameter.body: For your Friday 10:00 AM maintenance visit, please bring both hearing aids, the charging case, and the clinic-compatible charging cable. Firmware maintenance cannot be completed without that cable. Accessory loan holds for Friday visits must be requested before noon on Wednesday, September 23.

parameter.content: I checked the desk drawer for Friday’s hearing appointment: the hearing aids and case are there, but the clinic cable isn’t. I’m pretty sure the frayed spare went out with electronics recycling last month.

parameter.subject: Friday loaner accessory availability
parameter.body: The accessory desk has two compatible charging cables available for Friday maintenance visits. Replies received before 12:00 PM today can hold one for pickup at check-in. After noon, Friday loaner holds close so the desk can prepare visit kits.

parameter.subject: Friday loaner holds closed
parameter.body: Loaner accessory holds for Friday maintenance visits are now closed. The clinic cannot accept walk-up cable requests or retail substitutes for Friday firmware work; visits without the required compatible cable will proceed with cleaning only and firmware maintenance deferred.
